correctness.rationale: The complete 169-tetrahedron complex reconstructs f=(21,190,338,169). A 170-by-170 facial-relation minor has determinant -125 and the full relation matrix has rank 167 modulo five, forcing H1 to be exactly (Z/5)^3. A basis of the three-dimensional mod-five cocycle space then gives exact homology coordinates. Exhaustion finds 984 graph triangles, 338 faces, and 646 nonfaces, all 646 nonzero. All 31 projective directions occur. The explicit order-three vertex permutation preserves every tetrahedron; its induced homology action is derived from the certified coordinates and checked on every graph triangle.

value.rationale: The Weber–Seifert space is a classical hyperbolic rational homology sphere whose first homology is entirely order-five torsion. Its 31 cyclic order-five subgroups form a natural projective plane PG(2,5). The finding resolves the complete first simple-cycle layer and shows that every projective homology direction already appears at the absolute minimum edge length, while only 40 of 62 unoriented nonzero element-pairs occur. The order-three direction-orbit structure adds a symmetry-sensitive organization not encoded by the known homology or face vector.
